question: Where should Gaṇeśāna be installed during the ritual arrangement?
premises: Gaṇeśāna is the object to be installed.
The installation has a specific location.
That location is the middle of the pedestal.
inference: Gaṇeśāna should be installed in the middle of the pedestal.
plain_english: One should install Gaṇeśāna in the middle of the pedestal.
